name: Lez Shoukan e Youkoso!
source:
Fantasy × non-human girls × yuri harem eroge!

Ordinary high-school girl Momijō Sakura is suddenly summoned to another world where only women exist.  
Unable to fall in love with anyone but females, Sakura takes a job at a brothel to survive.  
But one day, while working at the establishment called “Rose,” she is abruptly fired.  
Cast out, Sakura resolves to open and run her own brothel—so she can build the ultimate yuri harem in this new world.
translation:
幻想×非人类女孩×尤里后宫工口游戏吧！

普通的女高中生佐仓红叶突然被召唤到只有女性存在的异世界。
小樱无法爱上除女性以外的任何人，为了生存，她在妓院工作。
但有一天，当她在一家名为“Rose”的公司工作时，她突然被解雇了。
被驱逐后，小樱决定开设并经营自己的妓院，这样她就可以在这个新世界中建立终极的百合后宫。
